description: This Kotlin source file defines a singleton object `CanvasActionTrust` that handles URL validation and normalization for trusted Canvas actions within an Android application. It provides functions to verify if a URL is trusted based on predefined criteria, including schemes, hosts, and exact URL matching, supporting security checks for embedded web content.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Determines if a given URL is trusted based on matching against a list of trusted URLs or specific local assets.

methods.name: matchesTrustedRemoteA2uiUrlExact
methods.description: Checks if a candidate URI matches an exact trusted URI after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedRemoteA2uiUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI to ensure scheme and host are standardized, used in URL trust verification.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Attempts to parse a raw string into a URI object, returning null on failure.
